title: A message someone can use
summary: What changes when a health message is organised around a reader’s question, rather than the amount of information available? A draft on audience, materials and a clear next step.

title: What travels between languages
summary: An idea can cross a language boundary while losing the context that made it meaningful. This draft considers how a speaker might make room for both clarity and cultural detail.

title: After the store goes live
summary: A store launch creates a new set of questions. This draft separates observations, interpretations and decisions, using a hypothetical operating example.
